title: Monitoring and Observability Gap Diagram
purpose: Side-by-side comparison of the current monitoring state (console.log, appendFileSync, no APM/metrics) versus the ideal observability stack (pino, Sentry, Prometheus, Grafana, alerts).
audience: DevOps engineers, backend developers, engineering leads, SRE team
description: Paired comparison of 10 current state deficiencies versus 7 ideal state components. Current state: console.log scattered (100+), fs.appendFileSync debug.log (synchronous), no structured logging (format varies), no request logging (no morgan/winston), no APM (no Sentry/Datadog), no metrics (no Prometheus endpoint), no health checks (/health missing), no dashboards (no Grafana), no alerts (no PagerDuty/Slack), zero monitoring infrastructure. Ideal state: structured logger (pino/winston with JSON output and request IDs), request logger (morgan for response time tracking), APM (Sentry for error tracking and performance monitoring), Prometheus metrics (request count, latency, error rate), /health endpoint (DB + R2 + RPC checks), Grafana dashboard (system overview, API perf, errors), PagerDuty/Slack alerts (error rate thresholds). Each current gap maps to an ideal remediation.
preconditions: Backend server is running in production
Current logging is limited to console.log and appendFileSync
postconditions: All 10 gaps in current observability are documented
7 ideal state components are identified with remediation paths
Gap 7 (dashboard) and Gap 8 (alerts) both feed into the same ideal target

connections.label: Gap 2: Replace appendFileSync with structured async logging

securityConsiderations: appendFileSync writes PII to debug.log (see J-03)
No APM means security incidents may go undetected
No alerts means production outages require manual detection
performanceConsiderations: console.log is synchronous and blocks the event loop
appendFileSync is synchronous IO that blocks request processing
No health checks means dependency failures cause silent errors
annotations: Current: console.log (100+ scattered), fs.appendFileSync (synchronous), no structured logging
Current: no request logging, no APM, no metrics, no health checks
Current: no dashboards, no alerts, zero monitoring infrastructure
Ideal: /health endpoint, Grafana dashboard, PagerDuty/Slack alerts
Gaps 7 and 8 both feed into the same ideal target (alerting infrastructure)
